commits.summary: Restore signed Gradle build dependencies (verification pending)
commits.body:
Recover HTTP Builder 0.11.1 and its detached JAR and POM signatures after the full L15 build stopped at the documentation plugin. Both 2016 signatures match the key scoped to this component in each historical revision. Lock all three archived coordinates in one local Maven repository and resolve them under the exact upstream policies on both sides. The complete binary install now retains its side and stage if it stops.

Both empty-cache, offline Gradle preflight resolutions passed. A modified JAR was rejected by its digest and by both signing policies. Example 437 reproduced all six public histories, the 29 selected suites passed, and the pipeline layout validated. Job 20261125-190630-build-gradle-l15-with-three-verified-his repeats both full installations and compares the six filesystem histories.

commits.summary: Fetch the exact Commons RNG snapshots for the Cauchy replay
commits.body:
The release and development reproducer used to ask the Maven Central release repository for a mutable SNAPSHOT name. Lock the original timestamped Apache URLs for both RNG JARs, qualify their SHA-256, and retain a digest-keyed copy with the historical classpath filename. A newer Maven alias can coexist with the frozen input.

Downloaded both artifacts into an empty snapshot cache and reused them offline. All 18 picocli, JGraphT and Commons Statistics histories matched their committed receipts, as did the original campaign's 12 jOOλ histories. An offline fixture recovered the correct timestamp behind a moved alias and rejected a damaged replay cache. The changed-test selector had no additional suites.

commits.summary: Trace six more merged Java changes at their original methods (verification pending)
commits.body:
Register original-method checks for RDF4J, Calcite, Iceberg, Guava in both editions, RxJava and JSqlParser. A saved trial must match the source pin and classpath, every historical caller class, the selected question and live invocation site, and both physical returns. Store large debugger reports whole in gzip. The L-series audit now also enforces the brief's original refutation and three roles for each of the twenty cases.

The retained Calcite JDBC intent reached ProjectSetOpTransposeRule.onMatch in four fresh JVMs with the registered outputs. Both campaign audits reproduced unchanged. The offline receipt checker accepted the three collected L-series reports and all five earlier campaign reports. Negative fixtures rejected altered inputs, bytecode, call sites, loaded classes, returns and verdicts. The selected unit test, cost lint and pipeline validation passed.

Jobs 20261125-192910-trace-rdf4j-calcite-and-jsqlparser-origi, 20261125-192910-trace-guava-aggregation-and-rxjava-group and 20261125-192910-trace-iceberg-record-copying-during-equa check 76 fresh debugger trials across seven deployments.

commits.summary: Confirm both complete Gradle builds against their embedded revisions
commits.body:
The full binary installations at Gradle PR 21084's two Git revisions built under the original dependency policies. Check the commit embedded by Gradle itself, every installed file, the exact launcher, core JAR and executing AbstractTask. Compare all six observed task outcomes and file contents with the registered caller. The parent kept A after edits to either action; the merge wrote B and both unchanged repeats skipped.

Job 20261125-190630-build-gradle-l15-with-three-verified-his passed. Its collected output matches the recorded SHA-256. The confirmation checked 239 files per installation and reproduced the committed identities and histories byte for byte. Negative controls rejected a swapped source commit, changed classpath digest or return, missing control, incomplete step and changed trust evidence. Example 437's replay and all 29 selected suites passed.

commits.summary: Trace Calcite's UNION ALL control (verification pending)
commits.body:
The original-method job for Calcite stopped because it required the transpose rule to run on UNION ALL. Wrap the original JDBC caller with Calcite's public planner hooks and listener. Both revisions remove the outer UNION projection during field trimming and return both tens with zero transpose attempts. Both revisions attempt the rule for EXCEPT and INTERSECT, and only the parent produces the narrowing transformation.

Twelve fresh listener JVMs repeated the recorded rows, converted and trimmed trees, attempts and successful transforms. The separately capped intent and duplicate-input debugger checks reached the original onMatch twice on each revision. A changed call count, tree or returned row failed the listener check. The 432 replay validator, all 29 selected suites and the job layout passed. The successful RDF4J and JSqlParser outputs from the earlier batch were independently checked in place.

Job 20261125-194115-verify-calcite-set-operation-matches-and independently repeats eight positive method-entry trials and all twelve public listener trials. The two earlier successful query steps remain in their original job outputs.
